body:
## Problem and change

Source packages currently expose 11 non-portable CUDA paths and depend on registry access for locked Rust dependencies. This candidate bundles the unchanged 766-file engine and 81 locked crates as source archives, extracts engine sources transactionally during configure, and builds with locked/offline/two-job Cargo commands. It preserves runtime code, kernels, dependency versions, API and numerical tolerances.

Four exact wasm-only compiled assets are omitted with recorded hashes and the corresponding Cargo file-inventory adjustment; all native source/license bytes remain unchanged. Git attributes preserve exact checkout bytes. A Windows CPU source-package check is added alongside the existing nine checks. Windows has not yet passed; this PR remains draft.

## Validation

- Four source-bundle controls, nine R configure/extraction controls and the affected MSRV controls passed.
- Linux/Windows/macOS Cargo graphs resolved from shipped vendor with empty initial cache and `--locked --offline`; no cross-platform build claim.
- Actual Linux source tar: 7,426,568 bytes, 321 files, no paths over 100 bytes; 320 files exactly match sources and DESCRIPTION retains original values.
- Fresh CPU production installation passed offline; 250 source functions, no selftest hooks, 27 compiled profile fields, no CUDA linkage/TEXTREL, zero compiler warnings.
- The corrected tiny-model probe verifies the documented no-tokenizer refusal and native closure. The original invalid text-generation expectation remains a recorded failure; there is no successful generation/quality claim and no native rebuild for the correction.
- One independent packaging review found two P2 issues (partial extraction and checkout byte conversion); the same reviewer approved their concrete closure.

Source build excluded vignette/manual building. Full platform checks and Windows execution are pending. See `docs/wp15-cran-plan.md`, `docs/wp15-cran-review.md` and `tests/cran/evidence/2026-10-18/` for retained raw failures and separate owner verification. No Phase 8 benchmark or consumed holdout replay.

## WP15 acceptance (verbatim; not yet fulfilled)

**WP15 — CRAN prep:** vendored crates per CRAN Rust policy; WRE compliance; submission. *Acceptance:* accepted (or blockers documented; r-universe continues).
Keep CUDA optional. Check Windows CPU build feasibility through CI/win-builder
without requiring a local Windows machine; resolve or disclose actual blockers.
Windows GPU acceptance and optional interactive VM work remain separate later work.

This is the first packaging/portability milestone, not CRAN approval or a new release. Remaining WRE/resource/license/size and R-devel/final submission checks stay open. Final submission, publication and merge require a concrete founder decision.
